description: This file contains a Smarty plugin function 'smarty_modifiercompiler_unescape', which compiles the 'unescape' modifier for Smarty templates. It handles unescaping of HTML entities, URLs, and other types within Smarty's template compilation process.

methods.name: smarty_modifiercompiler_unescape
methods.description: Compiles the Smarty 'unescape' modifier which unescapes HTML entities, URLs, or returns the input unchanged based on parameters.
